specification.purpose: Fresh prior-predictive local-level observation-residual computational breadth screen; no calibration or real-market usefulness claim

candidate.policy: Compile once per dataset; restart full warmup and retained sampling at each tier, using identical declared seed and canonical starts; charge every attempted tier

reference.policy: One warmup; fixed 1000-draw retained batches continue state with frozen adaptation; screen at declared tiers; charge every batch/check
reference.tuning_basis: Prospectively chosen algorithm-specific setting from earlier training case local00 reference retained divergences and separate long-path reference divergence; not selected using this fresh cohort

initial_positions.source: Observed-data formula, identical canonical matrix for both arms
initial_positions.formula: For c=0,1,2,3: offset=(c-1.5)*0.02; h_t=y_t+offset; log_sigma_obs=log(0.08)+offset; log_sigma_rw=log(0.12)-offset

screen.health_scope: All 130 canonical coordinates plus all five selected functionals
screen.endpoint_scope: All five functionals and one-step observed forecast
screen.forecast: Observed log-price at elapsed trading time 1, including both future process innovation and Student-t observation noise
screen.stop: First passing declared tier; otherwise retain maximum-tier failure

denominators.policy: Preserve every planned cell, including timeout, compilation, numerical, health and precision failures; no silent replacement or seed exclusion

seed_audit.status: Preliminary limited scan found no collisions; authoritative tracked-text/manifest audit deferred to root after timing
seed_audit.scope: STUDIES/options_flow_v1 JSON/Python/Markdown files up to 2MB, excluding raw arrays and target build paths
seed_audit.method: rg -l -w over the three explicit 24-value ranges
seed_audit.limitations: Raw posterior arrays and files exceeding 2MB excluded to avoid live timing contention; seed-bearing plans/reports/specs included
seed_audit.streams: Dataset, chain, prediction ranges pairwise disjoint

execution_rules: Freeze source hashes, adapter/extension identity and fixture hashes before execution; no live edits
Balanced pair order: candidate first for indices 0,8,16; reference first for 5,13,21
No further accept-probability or adaptation tuning based on this fresh screen
Do not treat unhealthy reference as posterior truth
Include compilation, imports, diagnostics, serialization and all attempted sampling in workflow costs
Generate fixtures only after current long-path experiment is terminal; this spec does not launch execution

seed_audit.method: Exact integer-token search over git-tracked study JSON/Python/Markdown <=2MB; raw arrays excluded by tracked corpus; only reviewed mocked-test references found

benign_test_references.reason: Reviewed mocked subprocess/fixture generation unit-test constants; no real prior draw or sampler stream executed
Reviewed mocked subprocess/fixture generation unit-test constants; no real prior draw or sampler stream executed

seed_audit.limitations: Explicit seed-token collision audit, not symbolic enumeration of unrecorded computed namespaces

candidate_default_attestation.explanation: pymc_workflow.sample_fit calls owalnuts.sample without adaptation overrides; Python adapter forwards default config; Rust parse_adaptation gets default_target_accept from Adaptation::default, defined as DualAveraging target_accept 0.8 in src/sampler.rs.

cache_policy: Retain existing disk caches; new worker process each cell; no cache clearing; compilation and imports charged
runtime_parity_policy: Candidate runs independent JAX density/gradient parity every invocation; cost charged; reference normalized-density correctness covered by source-bound preflight tests
inference_scope: Standalone fresh-cohort reliability screen; not a paired causal geometry comparison against historical centered cohort
retry_policy: Never restart a started cell automatically; preserve timeout/exception/missing-report costs and failures
